d.ko: Experience massive battles with infantry, tanks, artillery, and aircraft on large destructible open-world maps. Equip yourself, coordinate with your squad, and fight through World War II in singleplayer, co-op, or multiplayer!
d.en: Experience massive battles with infantry, tanks, artillery, and aircraft on large destructible open-world maps. Equip yourself, coordinate with your squad, and fight through World War II in singleplayer, co-op, or multiplayer!
d.zh: 步兵与装甲车、坦克、大炮以及飞机协力共同参与庞大的战斗。现实地管理你的武器和装备，和你的小队通力协作，有战术地在广袤的、完全可破坏的开放式地图上移动。在单人、PVP 以及合作模式中体验二战。

In my first match I killed a German soldier with a burst from my LMG before realizing he was trying to surrender. I didn't know the AI could surrender in this game. I wasn't punished at all for committing a war crime. …
enlisted but made with actual effort and genuine passion. My favorite fps genre has always been ww2 games, and this is it man. …
It's fun for the most part, but needs major balancing with almost every mission being attacker sided, both in multiplayer and singleplayer. …
听说制作人马可明年来中国旅游，无论是为了游戏，亦或为了历史，甚至更远大的事业（the greater good），南京玄武区都会热烈欢迎您！
游戏质量中等普通，不是3A大作，无聊时当小游戏打一局还可以。 但是，一家小工作坊，历史比较考究，愿意做抗日战争，这就值得一个好评。
